note: Role is clearly a trader/importer-exporter of industrial automation components (hydraulic cylinders, sensors, bearings, nozzles), not a manufacturer — declared industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' does not match the observed product flow (HS 84821090 bearings, 84123100 pneumatic cylinders, 90262000 sensors, 84689000 welding/nozzle parts). Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs rows with B/L numbers and destinations (Colombia, France, plus buyer-side lanes to Russia, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Bangladesh). Domestic supply side is genuinely unknown, not 'conditionally accepted' — no GST/tender/contract evidence was obtainable within the tool budget.
